name: Florian K.
headline: Bringing innovation to patients
summary: Seasoned health sector professional with 15 years of experience in improving healthcare through innovative solutions. My mission is to support the growth and success of new healthcare solutions by providing them with access to capital, networks and know-how. I leverage my expertise in health economics to assess the value and impact of digital health applications and tailor comprehensive go-to market strategies. I am passionate about creating value for patients, providers, and payers by bridging the gap between science, technology, and business.

positions.title: CEO for DACH region
positions.description: I’m leading the DACH expansion of Prosoma – a digital health startup focused on supporting cancer patients during their journey. Our mission is to provide the best quality of life support for people living with and surviving cancer. Our first product "LivingWellPlus" is an easy access psycho-oncological hybrid care solution. My focus is on strategic growth, partnerships, and building a sustainable care ecosystem.

company.name: Prosoma
company.tagline: Prosoma Digital Healthcare provides comprehensive solutions that improve the quality of life for cancer patients.
company.description:
💡 We are a global, interdisciplinary team of world-class scientists, psychologists, and engineers, as well as experienced and passionate new-tech entrepreneurs. We were brought together to deliver digital healthcare solutions at the forefront of innovation for oncology.

💡 In constant search for new solutions, our mission is to improve existing mental health care in the field by bridging the respective gaps and addressing emerging challenges and needs of stakeholders across the system.

💡 We believe that the future of cancer-related mental health care is digital, scalable, and patient-centered. Our solutions' potential for widespread impact allows them to not only enhance the patient’s quality of life but also to reduce healthcare costs and economic burdens, thus contributing to the overall resilience of healthcare systems.
